title: Notifications
preferences_desc: Select which channel you want to receive each type of notification. The in_app channel (bell) is always active. Only channels configured by the administrator are shown.
no_gateways_configured: No gateways configured. The administrator must activate at least one gateway (Email, Telegram, Matrix, etc.) so you can choose delivery channels. Meanwhile, you will receive notifications in the app bell.
contacts_desc: Your contact details to receive notifications through the different channels. This data is private and not shared.
quiet_hours_desc: During this range, notifications will not be sent via external gateways (email, telegram, etc.). In-app notifications (bell) are always delivered. Leave empty to disable.
digest_mode_desc: Choose how to receive email notifications. Instant sends each notification separately. Daily digest groups all notifications of the day into a single email (at 8:00 AM).
digest_daily: Daily digest (one email in the morning)
webpush_desc: Receive notifications directly in your browser, even when the app is not open. No third parties required - works with the W3C Push standard.
gateways_desc: Configure delivery gateways. Prioritize federated and free networks (Matrix, XMPP, Telegram) over proprietary channels.
webpush_not_supported: Your browser does not support push notifications
webpush_vapid_error: Could not get VAPID key from server
webpush_auto_desc: VAPID keys are generated automatically when a user activates push notifications from their contacts page. You do not need to configure anything here. Just activate the gateway and users can subscribe from their settings.
channel_desc_email: Sends notifications by email via SMTP
channel_desc_xmpp: Free federated network - via HTTP API of the server
channel_desc_webpush: Browser push notifications - auto-configured, no manual data required
channel_desc_sms: SMS via Twilio, Vonage, or custom API
channel_desc_whatsapp: Meta Cloud API or custom API - proprietary
channel_desc_webhook: HTTP POST to a configurable URL
field_howto_email_host: The server address. Gmail: smtp.gmail.com. Outlook: smtp-mail.outlook.com. Your domain: smtp.yourdomain.com
field_howto_email_password: Your password or App Password (Gmail uses App Password, not your regular password).
field_howto_email_from_email: The email that appears as sender. Must match your SMTP user.
field_howto_email_from_name: The name that users will see. E.g.: Federated Network
field_howto_telegram_bot_token: The token that BotFather gave you when creating the bot.
field_howto_matrix_homeserver_url: The URL of your Matrix server. If you use matrix.org: https://matrix.org.
field_howto_matrix_access_token: Log in to your Matrix account > Settings > Help & About > Advanced > Access Token.
field_howto_matrix_default_room_id: Go to the room > Settings > Advanced > Room ID. Format: !abc123:matrix.org
field_howto_xmpp_endpoint_url: The REST API URL of your server. Prosody with mod_rest: https://xmpp.yourdomain.org/rest
field_howto_xmpp_auth_token: Authentication token configured on your XMPP server for the REST API.
field_howto_xmpp_from_jid: The bot's JID (Jabber ID). E.g.: bot@yourdomain.org
field_howto_sms_provider: Enter: twilio, vonage, or custom depending on the provider you use.
field_howto_sms_account_sid: In Twilio Console > Dashboard > Account SID. Starts with AC...
field_howto_sms_auth_token: In Twilio Console > Dashboard > Auth Token. It is your secret key.
field_howto_sms_from_number: The number you purchased on Twilio. International format: +1234567890
field_howto_sms_api_key: In Vonage Dashboard > Settings > API Key. Only if you use Vonage.
field_howto_sms_api_secret: In Vonage Dashboard > Settings > API Secret. Only if you use Vonage.
field_howto_sms_endpoint_url: The URL of your own SMS gateway. Must accept POST with phone and message.
field_howto_whatsapp_phone_number_id: In Meta Business > WhatsApp Manager > Phone Numbers > ID.
field_howto_whatsapp_access_token: In Meta for Developers > your app > WhatsApp > API Setup > Access Token.
field_howto_whatsapp_endpoint_url: If you use a custom gateway (not Meta), the URL of your API.
field_howto_whatsapp_auth_token: Authentication token for your custom WhatsApp gateway.
field_howto_webhook_endpoint_url: The URL that will receive the POST. E.g.: https://hook.zapier.com/hooks/catch/123456/abc/
field_howto_webhook_auth_token: If your endpoint requires auth, enter the token here. Sent as: Authorization: Bearer <token>
gateway_help_email_step_0: 1. You need an SMTP server (can be Gmail, Outlook, or your own server).
gateway_help_email_step_1: 2. If you use Gmail, create an App Password in your Google account (not your regular password).
gateway_help_email_step_2: 3. If you use your own domain, configure an SMTP server (Postfix, Mailgun, etc.).
gateway_help_telegram_step_0: 1. Open Telegram and search for the bot @BotFather.
gateway_help_telegram_step_2: 3. BotFather will give you a Token (something like 123456:ABC-DEF...).
gateway_help_telegram_step_3: 4. Copy that Token and paste it here.
gateway_help_telegram_step_4: 5. Each user must start a conversation with your bot and copy their Chat ID.
gateway_help_matrix_step_0: 1. Matrix is a free federated network (recommended). You can use matrix.org or your own server.
gateway_help_matrix_step_1: 2. Create an account for the bot on your Matrix server.
gateway_help_matrix_step_2: 3. Get the Access Token: log in to your account, go to Settings > Help & About > Advanced.
gateway_help_matrix_step_3: 4. Create or join a room for notifications.
gateway_help_matrix_step_4: 5. The Room ID is found in the room Settings (format: !abc123:matrix.org).
gateway_help_xmpp_step_0: 1. XMPP (Jabber) is a free federated network. You need an XMPP server with HTTP API.
gateway_help_xmpp_step_1: 2. Prosody with mod_rest allows sending messages via HTTP API.
gateway_help_xmpp_step_3: 4. Create a bot account on your XMPP server.
gateway_help_xmpp_step_4: 5. Configure the REST API URL and the authentication token.
gateway_help_webpush_step_0: Web Push is configured automatically. You don't need to do anything here.
gateway_help_webpush_step_1: VAPID keys are generated automatically when the first user activates notifications.
gateway_help_webpush_step_2: Just activate the gateway and users will subscribe from My Contacts.
gateway_help_sms_step_0: 1. SMS requires a provider. Recommended: Twilio (international) or Vonage/Nexmo.
gateway_help_sms_step_1: 2. Register with the provider, create an account and get a phone number.
gateway_help_sms_step_2: 3. Copy your credentials (Account SID, Auth Token for Twilio).
gateway_help_sms_step_3: 4. If you have your own SMS gateway, use custom with your API URL.
gateway_help_whatsapp_step_0: 1. WhatsApp Cloud API is from Meta (Facebook). You need a Meta Business account.
gateway_help_whatsapp_step_1: 2. Register your phone number in Meta Business Suite.
gateway_help_whatsapp_step_2: 3. Get the Phone Number ID and the Access Token.
gateway_help_whatsapp_step_3: 4. Alternative: if you have a custom WhatsApp gateway, use custom API URL.
gateway_help_webhook_step_0: 1. A webhook sends an HTTP POST to a URL that you configure.
gateway_help_webhook_step_1: 2. You can use services like Zapier, Make, n8n, or your own endpoint.
gateway_help_webhook_step_2: 3. The POST body contains: title, message, link in JSON format.
gateway_help_webhook_step_3: 4. If your endpoint requires authentication, configure a Bearer Token.
